question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**particular**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Particular**" is an adjective that means "specific" or "distinctive."
 
• It is often used to indicate something that is different from others of its kind.
 
 
• **Example**: "*I am looking for a particular book that I saw in the store yesterday.*"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**In particular**," is a phrase that means "especially" or "specifically."
 
• "**Especial**," is an archaic form of "special."
 
• "**Accurate**," means "correct" or "precise,".
